summary: The change rechecks candidate expiry during planning and immediately before applying the repair, with a focused regression test.

evidence: scripts/codex-auth-repair.ts:729-732 captures a fresh planning timestamp after candidate assessment and applies without reusing the earlier timestamp.
src/codex/auth-repair.ts:235 rejects selected candidates whose expiry has passed at application time before mutating the pool.
tests/codex-auth-repair.test.ts:317-330 verifies that a candidate expiring between planning and application is refused and the pool remains unchanged.
